title: MZ [2024] Can I use RPG Maker Assets in Unity?

posts.author: sayllsayll
posts.body:
I bought RPG Maker VX Ace, MV, and MZ on Steam.
I want to use the RPG Maker default assets and things created with them in Unity and other game engines.
I know this wasn't allowed before.
But I heard that RPG Maker might have changed its rules recently.
Can I now use RPG Maker's default assets in other game engines?
If it's okay now, can you show me where it says this is allowed?
Thanks for your help!

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body: I think you can get the RPG Maker Unite stuff from the Unity Asset store. Beyond that, I don't think that's allowed.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
yes, the RM licence has been changed to allow more use of its assets.
There is a news topic about that somewhere, either here on this forum or on the official GGG website - sorry, I don't have the link and don't remember exactly what conditions there are now for using the assets in a different engine.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You can use any RPG Maker assets from engines you own in any other game-making software you own.
The current terms of use are on the RPG Maker official Web site.
You can also find
several
threads here where it's linked/screenshotted if you Google.
